briefTitle: A Phase 1/1b Study of IAM1363 in HER2 Cancers

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have relapsed/refractory HER2-altered malignancy; for selected cohorts, prospective confirmation of HER2 alteration by central testing is required
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: HER2 alterations are not among the allowed typed biomarker checks (EGFR, ALK, KRAS, ROS1, BRAF, PD-L1).

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have progression of disease after the last systemic therapy, or be intolerant of last systemic therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Disease progression status and treatment intolerance are subjective clinical judgments.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have radiographically measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 and/or RANO-BM
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have adequate baseline hematologic, liver and renal function
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General adequate organ function without specific numeric cutoffs is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥ 50%
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: LVEF is not among the allowed typed organ function or lab checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Able to swallow oral medication
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Ability to swallow is a subjective clinical assessment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Clinically significant cardiac disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Clinically significant cardiac disease is an investigator judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Infection with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-1 or HIV-2. Exception: Participants with well-controlled HIV (e.g., CD4 >350/mm3 and undetectable viral load) are eligible
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: HIV status with conditional CD4 and viral load rules does not map to a standard typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Current active liver disease including hepatitis A, hepatitis B , or hepatitis C
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active liver disease is an investigator-assessed clinical condition.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Refractory nausea and vomiting, malabsorption, external biliary shunt, or significant small bowel resection that would preclude adequate absorption
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Gastrointestinal absorption issues are clinical judgment items.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Uncontrolled diabetes
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Uncontrolled diabetes is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of solid organ transplantation
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Organ transplantation history is not a standard typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of Grade ≥2 CNS hemorrhage, or any CNS hemorrhage within 28 days before C1D1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: CNS hemorrhage history and grading is not a standard typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior history of non-infectious interstitial lung disease (ILD). (Exceptions: participants with prior grade 1 ILD that has completely resolved are eligible)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Interstitial lung disease history is not a standard typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants requiring immediate local therapy for brain metastases
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Requirement for immediate local therapy is a clinical judgment, not a clean brain_mets status check.
